### God's Chosen Remnant
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-chosen-remnant
Passage: Romans 11:1-5
Points:
- Paul addresses whether the inclusion of Gentiles means God has discarded ethnic Israel.
- The apostle points to his own heritage and faith as proof that God has not abandoned ethnic Israelites.
- God's answer to Elijah demonstrates that the Lord has consistently preserved a faithful remnant by grace.
- The existence of Jewish believers in Christ confirms God's steadfast commitment to His promises.
- God's ongoing faithfulness to His covenant people assures believers today that He will never reject them.
